title: Hybrid label on terminal nitrogen
statement:
In H–C≡N, what hybrid label is assigned to the terminal nitrogen in the localized model?

[_]{a}

explanations: One hybrid forms sigma overlap and one holds the lone pair.
Counting all three shared pairs as domains gives an incorrect count.

hints: Count the N–C triple bond as one domain.
The N lone pair adds one domain.
Two domains match the two-hybrid model.
solution: Count the N–C triple bond as one domain. The N lone pair adds one domain. Two domains match the two-hybrid model. One hybrid forms sigma overlap and one holds the lone pair.
